dict.string: APEX OS uses Bonjour over local Wi-Fi so your iPhone app discovers and syncs Apple Health vitals automatically.
APEX OS requires microphone access to analyze acoustic vocal pitch and thoracic resonance.
APEX OS uses front camera computer vision for TrueDepth photogrammetric facial landmark mapping.
APEX OS requires read access to Apple HealthKit to analyze cardiovascular recovery, HRV, VO2 Max, and active caloric expenditure.
APEX OS writes workout sessions, sets, and active energy samples directly into your Apple HealthKit store.
APEX OS imports clinical biometric records from Apple HealthKit for PhenoAge epigenetic scoring.
